onlinesearches-intelius-peopleconnect.evidence: Homepage form (first_last_name, city_state) has no action: the page's script opens /name/<first>-<last>/<ST>/<City>?category=public. The stored GET to the homepage only reloads it. The lowercase path without the category parameter shows the same results. Frame fills path placeholders as lowercase slugs and stops the path before the first segment it cannot fill, so a person with no city still gets the name (and state) page. Re-checked 2026-10-19: for a name it has no page for (Quillon Vanderwekken, CO), the hand-off lands on www.intelius.com/search/?affid=…&src=ONLSRCH, Intelius's "Searching for … in CO" funnel. The search is Intelius's (catalog entry intelius-peopleconnect, read on its /results/ page), so it is marked as an affiliate, not searched twice.
